collision_energy.evidence: Sixteen tandem mass spectra were collected in a data-dependent manner following each survey scan using 60 second exclusion for previously sampled peptide peaks using normalized collision energy 28.

fractionation_method.evidence: For LF, an aliquot (600 µg) of total protein digest was fractionated using basic pH reversed phase HPLC, adapted from the method published by Mertins et al.
bRPLC separation was carried out on Dionex Ultimate3000 UPLC using a 2.1 mm ID×50 mm column (XBridge, Waters) packed with C18, 3.5 µM particle size at a 0.2 ml/min flow rate.
